g.text: Sequence Diagram - AA03 Automatic CUSTOMER Role for a New Account (local registration)
The same rule applies to every way an account is created:
In all cases the role is set inside the User factory, never received as input.
All errors use the errorHandler format { error: { message, status } }.
interaction ends: the existing account is
NOT re-created and its roles are untouched (BR 5)
the back end alone decides the
INSERT INTO users (..., roles = '{CUSTOMER}', active = true)
{ id, name, email, roles: ["CUSTOMER"], active: true, marketingConsent, createdAt }
